screen.anyfind.search.title: AnyFind: search containers
screen.anyfind.search.unsupported: The server doesn't have AnyFind installed
screen.anyfind.config.title: AnyFind settings
screen.anyfind.config.radius.tooltip: How far around you containers are scanned. The server caps it at 128.
screen.anyfind.config.ctrl.tooltip: When on, the search opens with Ctrl + the key. Turn it off only if the key doesn't clash.
screen.anyfind.config.containers.tooltip: Lets you open the search while a chest or your inventory is open.
screen.anyfind.config.structures.tooltip: Leaves out chests inside dungeons, villages, mineshafts and other generated structures, even ones you already opened.
screen.anyfind.config.box.tooltip: Draws a box around every chest holding the item, visible through walls.
screen.anyfind.config.path.tooltip: A trail of particles flowing from you to the closest chest.
screen.anyfind.config.marker.tooltip: Column of particles above the closest chest.
screen.anyfind.config.duration.tooltip: How long the highlight lasts. It also turns off when you reach the chest.
